name: Tycoon RNG
desc:
Build the factory of your dreams! One roll at a time...

Join Private Servers for Reduced Lag, they are FREE!

Our take on the RNG genre lets you roll for all sorts of Droppers, Upgraders, and Furnaces to help you Build a Tycoon that you can flex off to other Players!

Rare Collectibles Spawning on the islands can be picked up and used in insane combos that give you OP boosts.

Join our Community Server for Updates!

This game is in ALPHA! We may mess up sometimes, but we'll try our best to make the best game possible!
